The chairman and members of the Committee may
designate qualified and competent representatives
to act in their stead.
The Inter-Departmontal Committee shall have
the following functions:
1. To organize and sponsor periodic national
conferences to insure that programs for
the development of children and youth
are continuously relevant to the times.
Cach conference shall be known as the Pre-
sident's Conference on Children and Youth;
2. To assist national agencies that have pro-
grams for children and youth to plan and
work cooperatively in an integrated manner
so as to reinforce each other in meeting tho
responsibility of the government toward the
young generation.
The Secretariat of the Inter- Departmental Com-
mittee shall be in the National Economic Council,
which shall render the necessary staff support and
technical assistance.
This Order shall tako effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of
April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-one.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) FLORES A. BAYOT
Acting Executive Secretary
